name: button
title: Button
description: UI SDK Button with variants: async pending state, a loading prop with a spinner, focusable-when-disabled, link rendering. ButtonLink is a Link with the Button look, for calls to action that navigate.
docs: Return a Promise from `onClick` and the button stays pending until it settles: `aria-busy`, presses ignored, focus kept, a spinner, and `pendingAnnouncement` after a second. For work the button didn't start (a form submit, a mutation elsewhere), pass `loading`: it renders the same state through `disabled` + `focusableWhenDisabled`, as UI SDK documents for external pending flags. The spinner takes the leading icon's place, or sits centered over the label, so the width never changes. `size="icon"` requires `aria-label`.
